svg.title: Canaan in Genesis 10:15–19
svg.desc: Detail map of the Levant showing the sons of Canaan and the borders of Canaan named in Genesis 10:15–19. Green marks land watered by rain (today's climate: Köppen-Geiger, Beck et al. 2023, CC BY 4.0).

g.text: with Admah and Zeboyim; sites unknown
with Admah and Zeboyim; sites unknown
the sons of Canaan, and its borders
Not shown: the Girgashites, and Lasha
Climate zones: Beck et al. 2023, CC BY 4.0.
